customManagers.description: Keep the pinned standards CLI in the workflows current

packageRules.description: One PR for all non-major GitHub Actions updates, digests included.
One PR for all non-major Rust crate updates, requirements and lockfile alike.
One PR for all non-major npm updates of the docs site; this also absorbs the preset's OXC toolchain group.
One PR for all non-major npm updates of the Shiki benchmark harness.
One PR for the tool versions pinned across the workflows and package manifests (pnpm, mise), whichever manager detects them. Listed last so it wins over the groups above.
Hold TypeScript below 7 on purpose: the native TypeScript 7 compiler waits until the docs toolchain is ready for it. Remove this rule to receive TypeScript 7 updates.
